question:
What is the mode of the given data?

5, 7, 9, 7, 3, 7, 5, 7, 8, 6, 7
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mode is defined as the observation that occurs most frequently in a dataset.

Data: 5, 7, 9, 7, 3, 7, 5, 7, 8, 6, 7

Frequency of 7: 5 times

Frequency of 5: 2 times

Frequency of other numbers (3, 6, 8, 9): 1 time each

Since 7 appears the most number of times, it is the mode.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given Data: 5, 7, 9, 7, 3, 7, 5, 7, 8, 6, 7

Formula: Mode = Value with the maximum frequency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be191e432a6d759cdf37f2d8f74048c3503b5cfef2c4fe96155abf3642bfa2e2.png] 

⇒ Count of 3 → 1

⇒ Count of 5 → 2

⇒ Count of 6 → 1

⇒ Count of 7 → 5

⇒ Count of 8 → 1

⇒ Count of 9 → 1

⇒ The value 7 has the highest count (5).

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Formula

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship is: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

Median

Median is the middle-most value when the data is arranged in ascending order. For n=11, it is the 6th term.

Types of Mode

A dataset can be unimodal (one mode), bimodal (two modes), or multimodal (more than two modes).</p
